core_obligations: Upper bounds and equalizers (proof lines 8502-8521): the assumptions make the category of neighbourhoods nonempty, the compatibility with fibre products produces an upper bound for two neighbourhoods, and the compatibility with equalizers, expressed through fibre products, produces a morphism equalizing two parallel morphisms.
Conclusion (proof lines 8522): the concluding clause is the companion result on left exactness of the stalk functor.
proof_roadmap: Produce an upper bound for two neighbourhoods using compatibility with fibre products.
Produce an equalizer using the explicit description of equalizers through fibre products.
Invoke the companion result for the concluding clause.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives conditions on a functor and a site under which the category of neighbourhoods is directed, and deduces left exactness of the associated stalk functor (statement lines 8484-8498). The proof is a complete verification of the defining properties of a directed category: nonemptiness follows from the first assumption; an upper bound for two neighbourhoods is produced by taking the fibre product, using compatibility with fibre products (proof lines 8502-8510); and an equalizer is produced by writing it in terms of fibre products and using compatibility with them (proof lines 8511-8521); the concluding clause is then the companion result (proof line 8522). The non-formal content is the construction of the upper bounds and equalizers. The claim is H2: a structured verification with each input named.
